content.comment_body: I bought a [product_name] bundle with [product_name] and [product_name]. I created a simple ladder program in [product_name]. Or do I need to link I/Os between the HMI and [product_name] in a more complicated way? Tutorials mention Data Blocks, but I can't seem to access these options since I can't add my device as a supported hardware. This makes following the video guides difficult as I may be missing steps. 2) From what I've read, it looks like I should use M0.1, M0.2, etc. as links between the HMI and the [article_no], instead of I and Q. Is this correct? 3) I currently have a symbolic I/O field as a dropdown to pick a product for my machine. This choice updates a counter in my program within [product_name]. I think I need to create a tag in [product_name] set to output an integer, which will adjust the counter parameter. Does this make sense, and if so, how do I handle this within [product_name]? Sorry if these questions seem basic. I mostly learn by experimenting, so the manuals are tough for me. Any English video tutorials would be appreciated. I've been watching some YouTube videos, but the software version shown is different so I’m unsure what applies.

Although I’d read through them before, sometimes reviewing additional material helps with understanding the terminology. I'm still unsure about two things: First, is it possible to use an output from my PLC program in [product_name] to navigate to a specific screen in the HMI? For example, if Q4 becomes active, I’d like the HMI to switch to a designated screen. If this is possible, how do I configure it? Second, my machine needs to perform multiple cycles based on a selection made using a graphic I/O field in the HMI. I’ve watched a few videos on using the graphic I/O, but I haven’t found one that demonstrates its integration with the PLC logic. For instance, I want the PLC to move a motor through a sensor several times, depending on the number picked from a dropdown menu. Previously, in a ladder program for a CNC machine, I used a word variable from the HMI to preset a counter that decremented with each tool cycle, triggering an output at zero. Can I set up this type of logic here? If so, what steps should I follow? Thanks again.
